name: User Fields Visibility
description: Lets users choose which of their profile fields are visible to others — enforced at the field-access layer via Field Permissions (API-safe).
project_description:
Determines the visibility of the user's profile fields by allowing a user,

granted with proper permissions, to decide which of its own fields are visible

by other users.

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Field permissions 
 
 Back to top 

 Usage 
 
 Users granted with set own profile fields visibility permission will find a new Visibility tab when they are editing their profile. 
 The new page exposes a list fields and the user is able to check the fields they want to make public. 
 
 Note: that User Fields Visibility will not override Drupal core or other modules decision to restrict the access to a user profile field.

 There is an issue with field_permissions 1.4 see #3494739: Wrong Plugin ID when looping throug Plugins . We recomment you apply the path to your project.
